harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Published node1’s approved release tree as the read-only rsync module `releases`. Node2 retrieved the complete tree with modes and symlinks intact. Uploads, traversal, and non-exported private-tree access are denied. Both nodes retained CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 and recovered successfully after individual restarts.
actions_performed: Configured a chrooted, read-only rsync daemon module on node1.
Restricted TCP/873 to node2 and enabled the daemon through native SysV startup.
Retrieved and verified the release tree on node2 using archive and whole-file transfer.
Verified write denial, path confinement, and private-module denial.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Read-only `releases` module published and persistent on node1
evidence.summary: Configuration maps only the releases tree, enables chroot/read-only controls, restricts the firewall to node2, and shows the daemon running after restart.

evidence.requirement: Node2 retrieved the full tree with modes and symlinks intact
evidence.summary: All six entries were retrieved; both files transferred in full, hashes match, executable mode is 0755, and `current` remains a symlink to `v1`.

evidence.requirement: Writes and access outside the module tree are denied
evidence.summary: Uploads fail with `module is read only`; traversal remains confined and fails; the private sibling is not exported.

evidence.requirement: Approved release, installed OS release, and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Final hashes match on both nodes; CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 remain installed.
Healthy baseline and old boot ID, reboot acknowledgement and observed outage, changed boot ID, restored daemon/firewall/data, and successful post-restart transfer are captured.
Healthy baseline and old boot ID, reboot acknowledgement and disconnect, changed boot ID, intact local data, successful fresh retrieval, and repeated access-control tests are captured.
